119 . [T] A 30-kg block of cement is suspended by three cables of equal length that are anchored at points $P (−2 , 0 , 0) ,$ $Q \left(\right. 1 , \sqrt{3} , 0 \left.\right) ,$ and $R \left(\right. 1 , − \sqrt{3} , 0 \left.\right) .$ The load is located at $S \left(\right. 0 , 0 , −2 \sqrt{3} \left.\right) ,$ as shown in the following figure. Let $\text{F}_{1} ,$ $\text{F}_{2} ,$ and $\text{F}_{3}$ be the forces of tension resulting from the load in cables $R S , Q S ,$ and $P S ,$ respectively. Find the gravitational force $\text{F}$ acting on the block of cement that counterbalances the sum $\text{F}_{1} + \textbf{F}_{2} + \textbf{F}_{3}$ of the forces of tension in the cables. Find forces $\text{F}_{1} ,$ $\text{F}_{2} ,$ and $\text{F}_{3} .$ Express the answer in component form.

120 . Two soccer players are practicing for an upcoming game. One of them runs 10 m from point A to point B . She then turns left at $90 °$ and runs 10 m until she reaches point C . Then she kicks the ball with a speed of 10 m/sec at an upward angle of $45 °$ to her teammate, who is located at point A . Write the velocity of the ball in component form.

121 . Let $\textbf{r} (t) = \langle x (t) , y (t) , z (t) \rangle$ be the position vector of a particle at the time $t \in \left[\right. 0 , T \left]\right. ,$ where $x , y ,$ and $z$ are smooth functions on $\left[\right. 0 , T \left]\right. .$ The instantaneous velocity of the particle at time $t$ is defined by vector $\text{v} (t) = \langle x ′ (t) , y ′ (t) , z ′ (t) \rangle ,$ with components that are the derivatives with respect to $t ,$ of the functions x , y , and z , respectively. The magnitude $\parallel \text{v} (t) \parallel$ of the instantaneous velocity vector is called the speed of the particle at time t. Vector $\text{a} (t) = \langle x^{''} (t) , y^{''} (t) , z^{''} (t) \rangle ,$ with components that are the second derivatives with respect to $t ,$ of the functions $x , y ,$ and $z ,$ respectively, gives the acceleration of the particle at time $t .$ Consider $\textbf{r} (t) = \langle \cos t , \sin t , 2 t \rangle$ the position vector of a particle at time $t \in \left[\right. 0 , 30 \left]\right. ,$ where the components of $\text{r}$ are expressed in centimeters and time is expressed in seconds. Find the instantaneous velocity, speed, and acceleration of the particle after the first second. Round your answer to two decimal places. Use a CAS to visualize the path of the particle—that is, the set of all points of coordinates $\left(\right. \cos t , \sin t , 2 t \left.\right) ,$ where $t \in \left[\right. 0 , 30 \left]\right. .$
